model-347-p: Model 347 is an annual informative declaration of operations with third parties. Entrepreneurs and professionals are obliged to present Form 347 provided that they have carried out operations with third parties for an amount greater than € 3,005.06 during the calendar year (the amount can be different), separately calculating deliveries and acquisitions of goods and services.
